verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a sandbox execution platform, but the evidence only describes Modal as a managed cloud service ("a platform for running AI workloads in the cloud"). The community "self hosted" mention refers to GitHub Actions runners built on top of Modal, not to self-hosting Modal itself. The GitHub repo is the client SDK, not the core platform.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
